text:
maria: Heads-up — found a mashup of issues when using the JS SDK in a Vite dev build targeting Edge workers. Repro in our sample app (next-starter) — auth retry loop + type errors only show up when bundling ESM -> dev worker.

maria: Repro steps:
1) clone repo, use @redwood-inference/js v0.15.0 (ESM-only)
2) vite dev, target: 'webworker' / service-worker / edge
3) call client.generate() immediately on module import

maria: Observed: infinite auth retries (401 -> retry -> 401). console shows import order weirdness, and TS types for client are "any" in the dev overlay. Prod build (vite build -> deploy) works fine.

maria: Paste of error in overlay:
```
Error: Unauthorized
    at fetch (node:internal/fetch)
    at authenticate (/src/sdk/auth.js:42:12)
    at index.js:5:1
```

sam: hmm. do you have a minimal repro? can you share package.json + vite config?

maria: Pasted important bits:
package.json:
```json
{
  "name": "next-starter",
  "type": "module",
  "dependencies": {
    "@redwood-inference/js": "0.15.0",
    "vite": "^5.0.0"
  }
}
```
vite.config.ts snippet:
```ts
export default defineConfig({
  worker: {
    format: 'es'
  },
  optimizeDeps: { include: ['@redwood-inference/js'] }
})
```

lee: quick guess — Vite optimizeDeps prebundle can turn ESM into CJS-ish shims for dev which can change import timing. If the SDK does auth at top-level import that can run before the worker globals are present.

anya: also worth checking exports/conditional fields in the SDK package. Vite's resolver sometimes picks the wrong entry (module vs browser vs exports -> default to cjs dev shim).

tyler: fwiw we had a similar edge typing glitch — tsserver in dev uses the prebundled files (node_modules/.vite) so the types can disappear if the package ships only .d.ts next to ESM and the bundler rewrites paths.

maria: Thanks. I tried forcing `optimizeDeps.exclude: ['@redwood-inference/js']` and that removed the retry loop (yay) but overlay still shows types as any. Also prod build still ok.

sam: two-pronged: we should (1) change SDK to be resilient to being imported at module evaluation time (defer auth until first request or check for global fetch/crypto availability), and (2) doc a recommended vite config for Edge dev.

lee: quick workaround for dev: dynamic import on mount instead of static import: `const { RedwoodClient } = await import('@redwood-inference/js')` — avoids prebundle injection. Not ideal but helps.

anya: For types: ensure package.json has "types":"./dist/index.d.ts" and that we ship TS declaration in the published tarball. Vite's tsserver should follow exports if package.json has proper exports map.

maria: I can assemble a tiny repro app and open an issue. Is there an internal template for Edge/Vite we should reference?

devex-bot: Reminder — when opening, include: minimal repo link, vite version, node version, OS. Tag eng-ml + eng-runtime.

maria: Will do. Plan: open GH issue + gist with minimal repo. Also proposing SDK change: lazy-auth + check for `globalThis.fetch` and `globalThis.crypto.subtle` before kicking off token refresh.

tyler: +1 on lazy-auth. Also add a small note in the DX guide: "Vite dev: if you see auth retry loops with Edge targets, exclude @redwood-inference/js from optimizeDeps or use dynamic import."

sam: Assigning follow-up: maria to open repro, eng-ml to review SDK lazy-auth design, devex to add Vite doc snippet.

maria: Filing now. I'll paste the issue link here when ready. :thumbsup:
